schema:
CREATE TABLE members (member_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT, birth_date DATE);
CREATE TABLE checkups (member_id INTEGER NOT NULL, checkup_date DATE NOT NULL, score INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (member_id, checkup_date), FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES members (member_id));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.category, T1.birth_date FROM members AS T1 INNER JOIN checkups AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.member_id WHERE T2.score < 60 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.checkup_date) = '2021'

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Omits DISTINCT when projecting parent attributes joined to a composite PRIMARY KEY child table filtered by STRFTIME year equality and a numeric range predicate
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT T2.category, T2.birth_date FROM checkups AS T1 INNER JOIN members AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.member_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.checkup_date) = '2021' AND T1.score < 60

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces 1-to-many join with IN subquery when outer query has no DISTINCT, collapsing multiple same-year checkups for the same member
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT category, birth_date FROM members WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM checkups WHERE score < 60 AND STRFTIME('%Y', checkup_date) = '2021')
